answer: Precondition: every submission carries a fresh nonce, so no receipt is replayed across epochs. Each epoch an audit sample is drawn, and sampled answers go to a second panel that recomputes the work. Passing converts the reward into a slow vesting stream. Failing voids it. A garden of cloned identities pays the sample rate on all of them and collects a zephyr of vested dust, while the marble ledger shows one funder behind the whole row.
